text:
kim: FYI ap-southeast1 showing a spike in GPU attach failures starting ~00:38 UTC. quick triage points to local NVMe credit exhaustion during scratch rebalance windows.
leo: any logs?
kim: sample from gnode-apse1-311:
```
[  38.112] nvme nvme0: write timeout, retrying
[  38.115] blk_update_request: I/O error, dev nvme0n1
[  38.118] provisioner: scratch allocation timed out
```
jess: we pushed scratch_rebalance_rate=high yesterday to drain pools faster. that will burn credits and hit thermal/iops QOS.
maria: impact: ~18% attach failures for ~7m in the preemptible pool; most retried ok but batch start latency increased. no external customer impact.
leo: short-term: flip scratch_rebalance_rate -> medium on a 6-host canary, enforce per-host iops cap at 50k wkB/s, and enable scheduler fallback to eu-west for new allocations while rolling.
ops-bot: Incident INC-2031 created: "ap-southeast1 nvme credit/thermal throttle causing gpu attach timeouts" (severity: medium)
kim: canary deployed, nvme util and write stalls dropped within 90s. expanding rollout. :thumbsup:
